description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the ObsValidator class in the OpenMRS project, specifically testing validation logic for Obs objects.

classes.name: ObsValidatorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for validating the behavior of ObsValidator in the OpenMRS project.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfPersonIdIsNull
methods.description: Tests that validation fails if the Person ID in an Obs object is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfObsDatetimeIsNull
methods.description: Tests that validation fails if the obsDatetime field is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfParentObsHasValues
methods.description: Tests that validation fails if parent Obs object has existing values set.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfObsHasNoValuesAndNotParent
methods.description: Tests validation failure when an Obs has no values and isn't a parent group.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfConceptIsNull
methods.description: Tests validation failure when the concept is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfConceptDatatypeIsBooleanAndValueBooleanIsNull
methods.description: Tests validation failure if concept datatype is boolean and valueBoolean is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfConceptDatatypeIsCodedAndValueCodedIsNull
methods.description: Tests validation failure if concept datatype is coded and valueCoded is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfConceptDatatypeIsDateAndValueDatetimeIsNull
methods.description: Tests validation failure if concept datatype is date and valueDatetime is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfConceptDatatypeIsNumericAndValueNumericIsNull
methods.description: Tests validation failure if concept datatype is numeric and valueNumeric is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfConceptDatatypeIsTextAndValueTextIsNull
methods.description: Tests validation failure if concept datatype is text and valueText is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfObsAncestorsContainsObs
methods.description: Tests validation failure if an ancestor group contains the current Obs object.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfAllValuesPresent
methods.description: Tests that validation passes when all required fields are correctly set.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfValueTextIsGreaterThanTheMaximumLength
methods.description: Tests validation failure when valueText exceeds the maximum allowed length.

methods.name: validate_shouldRejectAnInvalidConceptAndDrugCombination
methods.description: Tests rejection of invalid concept-drug combinations.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfAnswerConceptAndConceptOfValueDrugMatch
methods.description: Tests that validation passes when answer concept and drug concept match.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfFieldLengthsAreCorrect
methods.description: Tests validation passes when string fields have acceptable length.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfFieldLengthsAreNotCorrect
methods.description: Tests validation failure when string fields exceed length limits.

methods.name: supports_shouldSupportObsClass
methods.description: Checks that ObsValidator supports Obs class.

methods.name: validate_shouldNotValidateIfObsIsVoided
methods.description: Ensures validation does not proceed for voided Obs.

methods.name: validate_shouldNotValidateAVoidedChildObs
methods.description: Checks that voided child Obs are not validated.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailForANullObject
methods.description: Tests that passing null as object throws APIException.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfValueTextIsLessThanTheMaximumLength
methods.description: Ensures validation passes when valueText length is within limit.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfObsValueExceedsHiAbsolute
methods.description: Tests validation failure when numeric value exceeds high absolute limit.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfObsValueBelowLowAbsolute
methods.description: Tests validation failure when numeric value is below low absolute limit.

methods.name: getObs
methods.description: Utility method to create an Obs instance with specific properties for tests.
